notes.title: Japanese Trailer is released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.
We are pleased to announce the release of the Trailer for the Japanese version of "Mojiyuugi".

This video includes a part of the great adventure that "I" will challenge in the world of only letters.
Please check it out at
https://youtu.be/RUZmdpH8_TA


If you have already played "Chapter Zero", please add this "Full Version" to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2343610/_/?l=japanese
